title: feat(D9): memoize the defrost factor between learns, bit-identically
body:
A bit-identical memo for `DefrostDerate.factor`, the second-largest entry in
the coordinator-loop profile: between learns the answer for one exact
`(temperature, humidity)` pair cannot change, and a solve asks the same
handful of forecast pairs tens of millions of times, so the answers are
cached on the learner itself. Every plan's COP, every golden fixture and
both claim files are untouched by construction -- the memo returns the very
float the unchanged computation produced.

## The commission's 16 %, re-measured

The lead (round-9 pre-study `/private/tmp/r9-prestudy-replay/`, L6) named
`defrost.factor`/`_decide` at ~16 % of profiled wall. Re-measured with my
own instrument (cProfile over `tests/boost_drift_replay.py`, venv-ci +
hastub, full three-arm run, `seat/base.prof`): `factor` 30,331,805 calls,
cumulative 681.9 s of cycle's 3590.6 s (19.0 % cumulative); the defrost
family's exclusive tottime (factor + _decide + _interp_position) 348.4 s of
3587.9 s total (9.7 %). The pre-study's 16 % was `_decide`'s cumulative
share; my `_decide` cumulative is 14.6 % -- the lead reproduces in the same
band. After the memo (`seat/fix.prof`, same instrument): family tottime
12.2 s (1.0 %), `factor` cumulative 19.9 s (1.6 %), `_decide` calls
121,327,220 -> 11,440, `_factor_uncached` (the old body, verbatim) 2,860
calls -- one per distinct memo key per learner lifetime segment.

## Why the memo is bit-identical (the key is the finding)

`factor`'s output depends on exactly three things: the two normalized input
floats and the learner's grids. The grids move in exactly two places --
`observe()` and `observe_duty()` (`coordinator._settle_defrost`, once per
settled interval, synchronous in the cycle) -- and both clear the memo;
`from_dict` builds a fresh instance. Between learns the grids are frozen,
so a cached float equals the recomputed float to the last bit. The caller
pattern (`thermal_model._batch_cop`, called per substep per step) passes the
step's forecast scalars, identical across the batch rows and across all
548,562 batched evaluations a scenario costs. The computation itself moved
verbatim into `_factor_uncached`; nothing else in `defrost.py` changed
semantics. A NaN humidity never hits (NaN != NaN) and simply recomputes;
-0.0 collides with 0.0 and both produce identical arithmetic.

## Same-family survey (measured on `seat/base.prof`, treated or rejected)

| candidate | calls | cum s | share | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `defrost.factor` family | 30.3 M | 681.9 | 19.0 % cum | memoized (this PR) |
| `_two_zone_rates` | 15.6 M | 304.1 | 8.5 % | rejected: inputs are the per-candidate state being integrated -- solve-invariance fails by definition |
| `_substeps_and_loss` | 30.3 M | 193.8 | 5.4 % | candidate, not implemented: inputs (wind, rain, dt) are solve-invariant scalars, but the value also reads the shared mutable `ThermalParameters`, which the learners write in place between solves with no mutator choke point to invalidate on -- a stale entry would change plan values, breaking the bit-identical bar this commission set |
| `_zone_loss` | 15.6 M | 48.5 | 1.4 % | same objection as `_substeps_and_loss` (params-dependent) |
| `solar_gain_per_zone` | 15.6 M | 25.8 | 0.7 % | same objection; share does not justify the risk |

The defrost memo discharges the invalidation burden by construction (the
cache lives on the object with exactly two mutators); none of the others
has that property, so they are recorded, not implemented.

## Head

`84b8806d38305481a973d55625750113bb562cf6` is the orchestrator's recarry of main into the previous head. It is not a clean merge of the live head and main (parent 1 3bb3c2e2 is not the live pull-request head 84b8806d), so prepr checked this head.

`84b8806d38305481a973d55625750113bb562cf6` merges main `cb7cb25` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

3bb3c2e (1d408f215 failing test, e8ac3bb1e fix, 3acc434ad and 4254f16f
the mutation-autofix bot's pins, ede1464d the cap-exactness kill,
6439d94d the uniform-shortcut pin, 3bb3c2e the merge of the bot's pins).
All measurement was taken at e8ac3bb1e, whose tree differs from this
head's only by ledger pins and two test-only commits, each green on a
truncation run of tests/features.py at its own head.

## Mutation proof

Local null controls, each a hand mutant of `defrost.py` driven by the new
checks through a scratch truncation of `tests/features.py` cut at the
section boundary (kept with the seat logs outside the tree, not a tree
path; the section's semantics are unaffected by truncation -- everything
it reads is defined above it):

- memo removed / never stored / hit never returned -> `a repeated
  (temperature, humidity) pair is not re-decided` FAILs (4.0 interpolations
  per repeat); the full-tree base run showed the same red before the fix.
- `observe_duty`'s clear deleted -> `an observation invalidates the
  memoized answer` FAILs (stale 0.55 after the learn); `observe`'s clear
  deleted -> three checks FAIL, including the pre-existing `sustained
  evidence does move it`.
- key conflated to a rounded pair -> `the memoized factor is bit-identical
  to the uncached one everywhere` FAILs (28 of 150 sampled conditions,
  bucket edges included).
- cap never fires -> `the memo is actually bounded` FAILs (20001 entries).

CI's `mutation` check runs the scoped mutation table on the lines this
branch wrote.

## Unpinned sites

- `custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/defrost.py:162 CONST`
  (_FACTOR_MEMO_MAX): pinned by `the memo's cap is 8192 exactly` -- the
  doubled constant ends the 8202-pair sweep with 8202 entries against the
  required 10 (this was one of the two mutants the first table pass left
  alive; the cap-exactness check is the countermeasure).
- `custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/defrost.py:341 GUARD_OFF`
  (the hit return): pinned by `not re-decided` (mutant E in the proof
  above, 4.0 interpolations per repeat).
- `custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/defrost.py:343 CMP_BOUND` (the
  cap's comparison): pinned by `the memo's cap is 8192 exactly` -- a
  bound moved by one ends the sweep at 9 entries against the required 10
  (the other first-pass survivor).
- `custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/defrost.py:343 GUARD_OFF` (the
  cap's guard): pinned by `the memo is actually bounded` (mutant C,
  20001 entries).
- `custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/defrost.py:347 RETURN_DEL`
  (`return value`): a memo that stores but never answers returns None into
  the COP, reddening the drift gate and the memo checks outright.
- `custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/defrost.py:363 GUARD_OFF`
  (the uniform-surroundings shortcut, moved verbatim out of `factor`):
  pinned by `an empty learner's derate is exactly 1.0 across the plane` --
  the third site the table drove; switched off, the four-weight sum it
  skips lands off 1.0 at one sampled pair in thirty (measured 3379 of
  100000; the check's own mutant run reads 142 of 4000), so this guard is
  bit-identity, not speed.

## Null control

- The unmodified tree (clean origin/main, same interpreter) runs
  `tests/features.py` green (`seat/features-maincheck.log`, rc=0); with the
  test commit alone the new check fails at 4.0 interpolations per repeat
  (`seat/features-base.log`, the red the fix retires).
- `tests/boost_drift_replay.py` at clean main and at this head: rc=0 both,
  and every `ok`/section line byte-identical between the two runs
  (`seat/wall-base.log` vs `seat/wall-fix.log`) -- the scenario's value
  anchors (`converged_near` 1.0424 band etc.) are unchanged, the end-to-end
  bit-identity evidence.
- `git status tests/golden/` clean after the drift-mode gate; both claim
  files byte-identical to main (this diff touches neither).

## Figures

- `env PYTHONPATH="tests/hastub:tests:custom_components" python -m cProfile
  -o seat/base.prof tests/boost_drift_replay.py` (clean main checkout) and
  the same at this head (`seat/fix.prof`); shares read with `pstats`.
  Profiled defrost family tottime share 9.7 % -> 1.0 %; `factor` cumulative
  19.0 % -> 1.6 %; 30,331,805 calls, `_decide` 121,327,220 -> 11,440.
- Unprofiled sequential pair, user CPU time: main 1115.68 s, head 816.40 s
  (-26.8 %), `time` on the same command; sibling seats loaded the box
  unevenly between arms (75 % vs 91 % cpu), so the profiled shares and the
  per-call microbench are the load-independent figures and the wall pair is
  the directional one.
- Per-call microbench (seeded learner, venv-ci): uncached 6136 ns, memo hit
  444 ns; empty learner 5074 ns vs 293 ns.
- `tests/structure.py`: STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED at this head.
- `tests/features.py` full run at head: ALL 4045 FEATURE CHECKS PASSED,
  rc=0 (12:26 total).

## Red checks

- `tests/features.py` at the test-only commit: the new
  `not re-decided` check FAILs by design (failing test first), plus one
  unrelated FAIL (`an hour override is truncated to an int`) that did not
  reproduce at clean main in the same interpreter (`rc=0`) nor at this head
  (4045/4045) across three further runs -- attributed to a flake in that
  run, not to this diff; if CI disagrees, the cheaper detector discussion
  follows here.
- `mutation` (Tests run, both heads e8ac3bb1e and 3acc434ad): the table
  REFUSED -- 2 of the 5 sites this diff adds survived every driver after
  mutation-autofix pinned the other 3 (the cap constant doubled; the cap
  comparison moved by one). The cheaper detector than a full table pass is
  the one now built: a check that reads the cap's cycle arithmetic off one
  turn (8202 distinct pairs -> exactly 10 entries) and kills both mutants
  at zero standing cost. A third site surfaced when the table drove the
  moved `factor` body -- the uniform-surroundings shortcut at :363, which
  survived every driver because the memo's bit-identity check compares
  `factor` to `_factor_uncached`, two paths that share the mutation. It
  is not equivalent (measured: the four-weight sum lands off 1.0 at 3379
  of 100000 sampled pairs, a ~1e-16 COP perturbation on every
  empty-learner plan), so it is killed, not triaged: a 2000-pair exact
  sweep, miss and hit alike. Standing answer: every diff-added site is
  killed by a named check; no survivor_triage row is owed.
- None other. The scoped gate at e8ac3bb1e: `MODE: SCOPED -- 22 script(s)
  run, 11 scoped out`, rc=0 (`seat/gate.log`); `tests/stress.py` scoped out
  by the closure (no changed file in it), not skipped by hand. The gate's
  `env_drift.py --all` against the merge base -- every golden scenario
  captured from this tree and from the base in one environment and required
  identical -- is the drift-mode bit-identity proof, and it passed.

## Forward-carry

none

## Friction

none
